purpose: describe infrastructure as reviewed, versioned code so environments are reproducible and drift is visible
entry_criteria: Target environments and ownership are defined
State storage and locking are decided
procedure: Model resources in code with parameters per environment; keep secrets out of code.
Run format, validate and policy checks in CI.
Produce a plan against the target environment and review the diff, especially deletions and replacements.
Apply through the pipeline with the infra-owner's approval for production.
Detect drift on a schedule and reconcile by code, not by hand.
Record rollback: previous version of the code and state backup.
acceptance_criteria: State is remote, locked and backed up
validation_method: Infra-owner review of the plan before production apply.

validation.command: terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform validate   # example; use the project's IaC tool

validation.expect: exit 2 means changes pending; review diff; exit 0 means no drift

failure_modes.detection: Plan lists replacements of stateful resources

failure_modes.response: Reconcile in code; document who changed what
Rotate and move to the secret manager

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Adding a database replica changes one module. The plan shows one resource created and none destroyed; the infra-owner approves and drift check afterwards is clean.
